name: snapshot-inconsistency
description: RDB consistency after generate/load cycle — all types, values, and metadata preserved

phases.name: write
phases.description: Write 125 keys across all types (string, list, hash, set, zset, TTL)

phases.name: rdb_generate
phases.description: Generate RDB via GenerateRDB (single View txn)

phases.name: rdb_load
phases.description: Load into fresh store via LoadRDBWithStore

phases.name: verify
phases.description: Check(): no orphans, all keys readable, values match

invariants: store.Check() passes on loaded store (zero orphans)
All source keys present in loaded store with matching types
Values match exactly for all 125 keys across 5 data types
TTL metadata preserved for EXPIRE'd keys
RDB generated during concurrent writes produces valid, loadable snapshot
